text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bus heading to the summer training 
camp lodge is surrounded by many fans. 
However, Kitasan Black shows no sign of 
complacency.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Placing first in the fan poll is proof of 
the high hopes for her future. She vowed 
to build the strength this summer to 
answer those feelings.
